user.title: How is the gate controlled?
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant sends the pulse to your gate.

menu_options.entity: Via an existing entity (button, switch, lock or script)

unifi.title: Connect UniFi Access
unifi.description: Create the token in the **UniFi Access app** itself (Access → Settings → General/Advanced → API Token), with permission to view and unlock doors. A UniFi OS API key (Control Plane → Integrations) does not work here. The API runs on port 12445 of your console.

data_description.unifi_host: For example 192.168.1.1. Port 12445 is added automatically.
data_description.unifi_verify_ssl: Leave off: the console uses a self-signed certificate by default.

door.title: Which gate?
door.description: Pick the UniFi Access door that drives your gate.

gate.title: The gate
gate.description: Pick the sensor that tells whether the gate is open or closed. An example rule is added, and everything is on the Hekken page in the sidebar.

data_description.relay_entity: The UniFi Access button, switch, lock or script that moves the gate.
data_description.sensor_entity: Your Sensative strip. By default 'on' means the gate is open.
data_description.sensor_inverted: Tick if the sensor reports 'on' when the gate is closed.
data_description.travel_time: How long the gate takes to fully open or close. No new pulse is sent within this time, otherwise the gate stops or reverses.
data_description.retries: How many extra pulses before the gate goes into fault. 1 means: one pulse, one more after the wait, then fault.
data_description.presence_entities: Persons, phones or the Home zone. If anyone is home, rules with 'not when someone is home' skip closing.
data_description.notify_service: Optional, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty for a Home Assistant notification only.
data_description.retry_delay: If the gate does not respond to a pulse, the planner waits this long while watching the sensor. Still wrong after the last attempt? The gate goes into fault and nothing is sent until you reset it.

abort.already_configured: This sensor already belongs to a gate.

error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected. Use a token from the UniFi Access app itself (Access → Settings → API Token), not a UniFi OS API key (Control Plane → Integrations): that one only works for UniFi Network. Details: {error}
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant cannot connect to UniFi Access on port 12445. Check that Home Assistant can reach the console (VLAN or firewall). Details: {error}
error.no_doors: No doors found in UniFi Access.
error.invalid_cert: The console's certificate is not trusted. Turn off 'Verify certificate'. Details: {error}
error.api_error: UniFi Access answers but returns an error. Check the token's permissions. Details: {error}

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: A rule applies within its time window on the chosen days. Windows across midnight (22:00 to 06:00) are fine. Equal start and end mean all day.

data.name: Name
data.skip_when_home: Do not close when someone is home
data.open_at_start: Open at the start of the window
data.close_at_end: Close at the end of the window

data_description.auto_close: When the gate opens within this window (app, badge or here), it closes by itself after the set time.
data_description.skip_when_home: Applies to automatic closing and to closing at the end. When the last person leaves, the timer starts again.

data_description.travel_time: How long the gate takes to fully open or close. No new pulse is sent within this time, otherwise the gate stops or reverses.
data_description.retries: How many extra pulses before the gate goes into fault. 1 means: one pulse, one more after the wait, then fault.
data_description.retry_delay: If the gate does not respond to a pulse, the planner waits this long while watching the sensor. Still wrong after the last attempt? The gate goes into fault and nothing is sent until you reset it.
